// Emit the latency metric

// Check the avg arrival time is cleared

samzaTransformMetricRegistry.updateArrivalTimeMap("Count.perKey", first, 1048L);

// Check the avg arrival time is updated
assertEquals(1048L, samzaTransformMetricRegistry.getAverageArrivalTimeMapForGBK("Count.perKey").get(first).longValue());

// Check the avg arrival time is cleared
assertFalse(samzaTransformMetricRegistry.getAverageArrivalTimeMapForGBK("Count.perKey").containsKey(first));
